item.title: Trump Promotes Program to Reduce Medicaid Drug Prices
item.description: Ahead of the midterm elections, the president said that all states had opted in to an effort to align Medicaid’s prices for medicines with those in other wealthy countries.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Robbins
item.media:description: In his remarks Friday, President Trump framed the effort as a way for states to save money that could be reinvested in providing health care.

item.media:description: Dario Amodei, Anthropic’s chief executive, is said to have met with potential investors in the company’s blockbuser I.PO. in recent weeks.
